verdict.rationale: Grafana ships a documented REST/OpenAPI API (grafana-probe-3), a CLI for admin tasks (grafana-docs-26, grafana-docs-31, grafana-probe-5), and full 'observability as code' provisioning for dashboards/data sources/alerts enabling version-controlled, non-UI management (grafana-docs-2, grafana-docs-3, grafana-docs-16). This strongly suggests broad API/CLI coverage of core UI functions (dashboards, data sources, alerting), but no evidence explicitly claims 100% feature parity between UI and API, nor documents any UI-only features that lack API equivalents. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement or independent verification of full UI/API parity, and coverage of newer features (SLO, incident management, Adaptive Telemetry) via API.
